purpose: distributions by the insurer subsidiary declared after its 30.6.2026 solvency report was published (the report already deducts those declared before)

not_found.why: the Q3'26 report prints only the NIS 500m dividend the insurer's board decided on 17.11.2026 (p8, p26); the solvency report as of 30.6.2026 was published on 18.11.2026 and, per the report (p26, p29), already deducts it, so no distribution after the solvency report's publication is printed
